title: Young Girl Cathy Outdoors by Railing, 1950s B&W Deckle-Edge Snapshot Photo
description: A mid-century black-and-white snapshot capturing a young girl, identified as Cathy on the reverse, standing behind a porch or fence railing outdoors. She wears a patterned polka-dot crop top and matching shorts, bathed in strong natural light against lush garden foliage. The scalloped deckle edge and handwritten inscription reflect intimate mid-20th-century family leisure photography.
